mentions.name: The Influencer AI
mentions.description: This platform generates a consistent AI person and uses them to create images and talking videos. It lets a user go from the idea of a person in their head to a finished video of that person doing or saying anything, all on one platform, leveraging the best AI models for each step of the process.
mentions.source_excerpt: My wife and I have been working on a platform for close to year now, called The Influencer AI (https://www.theinfluencer.ai) that helps you generate a consistent AI person, and use them for images and talking video.
